summary: Tested Agenda de Eventos end-to-end. Backend: 57 pytest (44 regression + 13 new event tests), 56 pass, 1 minor fail (impossible dates like 2026-13-45 accepted). Frontend: /agenda calendar highlights event days (Nov 19/24, Dec 1/8), clicking day filters list, clear-day resets, day without events shows agenda-empty, month navigation works, month grouping (Novembro/Dezembro de 2026), cards link to /post/{id}; post detail shows event-info (date/time/location) + like/share/comments; Home shows home-upcoming-events with 4 cards + home-see-all-agenda link, events not in hero/side; Admin (Clerk ticket sign-in) evento filter shows 4, selecting Evento type shows admin-event-fields, saving without date shows 'Informe a data do evento' toast, created event appears in admin list and on /agenda (day 27 highlighted). TEST data cleaned up; 4 seeded events intact.

minor.issue: event_date regex ^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})?$ only checks format; impossible dates (2026-13-45) return 200 and are stored. Use a field_validator with date.fromisoformat.
'today' computed in UTC; in Angra (UTC-3) events for today disappear after 21:00 local time. Consider America/Sao_Paulo timezone.

issues: Selected day is visually indistinguishable from other event days (hasEvent class uses !bg override, so selected styling is lost) - add ring/outline for selected
Uses browser native <input type=date/time> pickers instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover (shows mm/dd/yyyy US format to a pt-BR user)
Header nav 'Agenda' not active when viewing an event post (minor)
